_variants_note: 1 owned card is a variant whose number collides with a tracked slot held by a DIFFERENT card: id1 Umbreon ex 060/131 (Prismatic Evolutions Surprise Box stamp). The pre-dr slot for 060/131 holds id20, the plain print, because that set is defined as 'the nine double rares, without stamps'. id1 has set_key=null and cannot be priced from an existing bucket. Give it its own bucket (e.g. "pre-stamp": {"060/131": ...}) and set its set_key to that. Do NOT point it at pre-dr: a stamped print and a plain print are different market items, and sharing one price double-counts the plain card's value.
